name: tyxter
description: WhatsApp Business messaging skills for the Tyxter API: sandbox sends, webhook testing and signature verification, templates, delivery debugging, billing usage, and SDK and CLI discovery.

TYXTER_MCP_URL.title: Tyxter MCP URL
TYXTER_MCP_URL.description: Your Tyxter MCP server URL, shaped https://api.tyxter.com/mcp/p/<project>/<environment>. Copy it from the Tyxter dashboard Connections page, MCP tab.

TYXTER_API_KEY.title: Tyxter API key
TYXTER_API_KEY.description: Tyxter API key sent as a bearer token to the MCP URL. Match the prefix to the URL's environment: a tx_sandbox_ key for a sandbox URL, a tx_live_ key for a production URL.
